title: The classification fields cannot be written through the Open API
custom_preconds:
BLOCKED ON RELEASE: this test checks the Open API story of Internal Work Orders (SV-11833), which is built after the Open API refactoring and does not ship with the core release. Do not run it now. It can be tested once SV-11833 is released.

Preconditions

  • Use an Open API key for the test organization, the Open API documentation, and a tool that sends API requests.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable.
custom_steps: 1. Send PATCH for work order 1 through the Open API setting classification to no_charge.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The change is refused.
  • A GET of work order 1 still reads classification billable.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories), story SV-11833 (Story 11, Open API and webhooks)

  • S11-R1: “The work order and invoice resources carry classification (billable, internal, no_charge) and category (the category key and name; the internal category on an internal work order, the no-charge category on a no-charge one); a no-charge work order carries original_work_order, original_line and original_technician when set. Lines carry no_charge (true or false), no_charge_category, original_work_order, original_line and original_technician; invoice lines show a no-charge line at 0 with the same fields. The customer resource carries internal (true or false) and default_internal_category; the asset resource carries internal_category. All are read-only in this version. The classification is the one written on the work order (S2-R13), never derived from the customer at read time.”
  • S11-R4: “Writes: a work order created through the API takes the classification and the category of its customer and asset (S2-R1); No Charge cannot be set through the API in this version, on a work order or on a line; prices sent on the lines of an internal or no-charge work order are dropped and cost and hours are kept (S2-E1); a customer change through the API follows S2-R7 without the dialogs. POST /v1/invoices (disabled today, to be enabled for GA) refuses an internal or no-charge work order with the error "This work order is internal or no charge. Close it in ShopView." and accepts a billable work order with no-charge lines, invoicing them at 0.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “(1) Every write in the matrix is refused by the server with 403 when the user lacks the atom, through the app and the mobile app alike; the UI hides the control, the server enforces it; QA verifies each write against the endpoint, not the menu. The Open API is outside the matrix: an API key carries no user permissions, so the classification writes are refused for every key (S11-R4) instead of being gated per user.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
